Simple remove the magnet by using a small flat head screwdriver or socket  5: Install the new magnet in the same position you just remove the old magnet from 6: No just re-install the speed sensor, re-attach the battery cables, and run the Tow/Run switch back to the RUN position.  If you have questions regarding if your Club Car has a IQ system with ADC motor or a GE motor. The easiest way to tell is by checking the serial number prefix. If your serial numbers starts with: AQ, CE, FD, HD, PE, or PQ then you have a cart with a IQ system. You can also look at the motor controller part number. If your model number starts with "1510" then you also have an IQ system.  This magnet will fit, but will NOT work on vehicles equipped with the Excel system. Excel vehicles have serial number prefixes of PH, PJ, PU or PD This magnet is a "half-pulse" magnet. Once installed on your motor it will still communicate to the speed sensor exactly as the other magnet did, but only half as often. This magnet won't give you a boost of power or torque it merely raises the electronic rev limiter so high that the vehicle will never reach it. In turn, you will be able to run the full potential of your vehicle..The regenerative motor braking becomes completely disabled when this magnet is installed and will allow you to "free-wheel" down hills. The magnet in this listing will fit any Club Car vehicle with the IQ drive system that is equipped with an ADC motor. There were two motors available with the IQ system. 1. GE - The GE is grey in color and uses a snap-in speed sensor. 2. ADC - The ADC motor uses a speed sensor shaped like a top hat that bolts on.

Also connects with the majority of Polar heart rate monitors on the market and compatible gym equipment. Includes a soft fabric chest strap that seamlessly adapts to your body shape. User replaceable battery. Includes limited two-year manufacturer's warranty. FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS: How should I wear the H7 sensor? Moisten the electrode areas of the strap with water, attach the connector to the strap and wrap the strap around your chest. The heart rate sensor should be worn flat against the skin with the Polar logo in the upright position. How should I clean the H7 sensor? Detach the connector from the strap after every use and rinse the strap under running water. Hang the strap to dry. When needed, hand wash the strap gently with a mild soap and water solution. Avoid moisturizing soaps. Do not soak, iron, dry clean or bleach the strap. Also, don’t stretch the strap or bend the electrode areas sharply. How should I store my H7 sensor? Store the heart rate sensor strap and the connector separately to maximize the battery lifetime. Keep the heart rate sensor in a cool, dry place. To prevent snap oxidation, do not store the heart rate sensor wet in non-breathable material. Also, don’t expose the heart rate sensor to direct sunlight for extended periods.
